subject: Kickoff: BRAC - offline RL from logged interactions
body:
Hi team,

Kicking off the BRAC workstream for agents-rl. The product motivation: we have months of logged interaction data from the assistant pilots, and no way to improve policies from it without risky live exploration. Behavior Regularized Actor Critic is our open-source framework for exactly this - offline RL with a behavior-regularization knob (choice of divergence, value penalty vs. policy regularization, Q-ensembles).

Plan: reproduce the continuous-control results first (SAC-trained partial policies as data collectors, then offline training on HalfCheetah-class environments), then port the recipe to one internal logged-data domain as a feasibility study.

Milestones: reproduction by end of March, internal domain feasibility readout by 5/1, go/no-go on a funded H2 program at window close 5/18.

Daniela - staffing and data logistics over to you.

Ulla
